menus.gate_is_active_effect: Query-level gate. A non-ADMIN's request filters is_active=True before it reaches them — an inactive entry is absent from their tree, not dimmed.
menus.gate_is_active_nonadmin: Read-only, no toggle shown — and even a role granted write access couldn't find an inactive row here, since their own reads filter it out too.
menus.gate_visible_effect: Sidebar-only. An invisible-but-active entry still resolves via direct navigation — only the sidebar listing skips it.
menus.gate_visible_nonadmin: Editing this menu at all requires menu.manage — ADMIN-only today.
menus.gate_permission_effect: The codename Menu.get_codename() would use if anything called it — nothing does yet, so this is dormant, not a live gate. Blank derives a guess from path.
menus.gate_permission_nonadmin: Editing this menu at all requires menu.manage — ADMIN-only today.
menus.gate_roles_effect: Coarser than permission — controls which roles see this entry at all. Empty list = public, not "nobody".
menus.gate_roles_nonadmin: Editing this menu at all requires menu.manage — ADMIN-only today.
menus.gate_menu_type_effect: DIRECTORY / MENU / BUTTON. Decides which of the other fields are meaningful — a DIRECTORY has no page.
menus.gate_menu_type_nonadmin: Editing this menu at all requires menu.manage — ADMIN-only today.
menus.gates_footnote: All five require menu.manage to edit at all — ADMIN-only in the current role setup.

profile.reborn_body: This life has ended. Posts are sealed and read-only; no following, reactions or comments.

menu.letter_request: Not mutual · send a request first
menu.letter_rule: Until they reply or follow back, one more every 24 hours. Same as letters.

me.title: My page
me.name_hint: 2 to 20 characters. No other soul in this civilization may already have it.
me.name_sensitive: That name contains a word that is not allowed. Try another.
me.name_taken: Another soul in this civilization already has that name.

list.reborn_note: Reborn souls stay in the list without buttons.

report.done_body: The hall will look at it. You get no separate result; the other side never learns who reported.
report.limit: You have used this 24 hours' reports; try again later.

search.title: Find people
search.scope: Only within {{civ}}. Names match loosely; a soul code must be all 10 characters.
search.result_note: Results show only a name and civilization mark.

delete.body: Once deleted, others can no longer see it, and it cannot be brought back.

rebirth_approved.title: Rebirth application approved
rebirth_approved.body: Your rebirth application was approved. Open Soul Ledger to see it.

rebirth_rejected.title: Rebirth application rejected
rebirth_rejected.body: Your rebirth application was rejected. Open Soul Ledger to see why.

rebirth_appeal_rejected.title: Appeal rejected
rebirth_appeal_rejected.body: Your appeal on the rebirth application was rejected. Open Soul Ledger to see why.

judgment_result.title: Judgment concluded
judgment_result.body: Your judgment has concluded. Open Soul Ledger to see it.

disposition_executed.title: Disposition carried out
disposition_executed.body: Your disposition has been carried out. Open Soul Ledger to see it.

residence_approved.title: Residence approved
residence_approved.body: You are about to be moved to reside in another civilization. Open Soul Ledger to see it.

residence_started.title: Residence begun
residence_started.body: You have been moved to reside in another civilization. Open Soul Ledger to see it.

residence_returned.title: Residence ended
residence_returned.body: You have returned to your home civilization. Open Soul Ledger to see it.

sentence_completed.title: Sentence served
sentence_completed.body: You have served your whole sentence and may apply for rebirth. Open Soul Ledger to see it.

sentence_waiting.title: Held after serving
sentence_waiting.body: You have served this stop and wait for a judgment to close before returning. Open Soul Ledger to see it.

sentence_amended.title: Sentence plan changed
sentence_amended.body: Your sentence plan has changed. Open Soul Ledger to see it.

sentence_pardoned.title: Sentence plan cancelled
sentence_pardoned.body: The rest of your sentence is waived and you may apply for rebirth. Open Soul Ledger to see it.

chat_message.title: New letter
chat_message.body: {{name}} wrote you a letter. Open Soul Ledger to read it.

password_help_requested.title: Password help requested
password_help_requested.body: Account {{username}} asked for a password reset from the sign-in page. Once you have confirmed who is asking, reset it under User Management.

dispatch_return_blocked.title: Residence return blocked
dispatch_return_blocked.body: Soul {{soul}} cannot return home while judgments stay open ({{count}}). It returns once they are concluded or withdrawn.

sentence_node_active.title: Sentence stop begun
sentence_node_active.body: Soul {{soul}} has arrived. Stop {{order}} of its sentence plan begins in {{tenant}}.

sentence_node_done.title: Sentence stop ended
sentence_node_done.body: Stop {{order}} ({{tenant}}) of the sentence plan of soul {{soul}} has ended.

sentence_node_waiting.title: Held after serving
sentence_node_waiting.body: Soul {{soul}} has served stop {{order}} in {{tenant}} and stays there while a judgment is open. It returns once the judgment is concluded or withdrawn.

sentence_node_refused.title: Sentence stop refused
sentence_node_refused.body: {{tenant}} refused the transfer for stop {{order}} of the sentence plan of soul {{soul}}. The stop is pending again.

sentence_plan_completed.title: Sentence plan completed
sentence_plan_completed.body: Soul {{soul}} has served every stop of its sentence plan.

cross_sentence_submitted.title: Joint sentence submitted
cross_sentence_submitted.body: {{tenant}} has submitted stop {{order}} of the sentence plan of soul {{soul}}.

sentence_plan_amended.title: Sentence plan changed
sentence_plan_amended.body: The sentence plan of soul {{soul}} has changed, involving {{tenant}}.

sentence_request_pending.title: Sentence plan request pending
sentence_request_pending.body: {{tenant}} has filed a request on the sentence plan of soul {{soul}}. It awaits the original judge.

sentence_request_decided.title: Sentence plan request decided
sentence_request_decided.body: The original judge has decided your request on the sentence plan of soul {{soul}}. Open it to see.

sentence_plan_cancelled.title: Sentence plan cancelled
sentence_plan_cancelled.body: The sentence plan of soul {{soul}} was cancelled. The rest of the sentence is waived and the plan counts as complete.

social_moderation.title: Circle moderation
social_moderation.subtitle: Reports, pending content, the word list and mutes for this civilization's soul circle
social_moderation.word_hint: Lower-case substring match; new posts and comments that hit it wait for review and are hidden until then
social_moderation.confirm_delete_body: It disappears from the soul app; the audit log keeps a record.
social_moderation.confirm_remove_word_body: New content will no longer be held for this word.

errors.already_resolved: This report was already handled (perhaps by another officer)
errors.invalid_transition: The content's status changed; refresh and try again
errors.duplicate_word: That word is already on the list
errors.invalid_resolution: A report against a user cannot hide or delete content; mute instead
errors.not_found: Not found, or not in this civilization

empty.content_reason: Only content that hit the word list waits here; reported content is in Reports

soul_inbox.title: Hall inbox
soul_inbox.subtitle: Letters souls write to this hall. Bodies live on the chat server, not in this database or the audit log.
soul_inbox.empty_reason: Letters a soul writes from the app to the hall it is in now appear here.
soul_inbox.select_hint: Pick a letter on the left
soul_inbox.thread_empty: This letter has no messages yet
soul_inbox.reply_hint: The soul sees a reply from the hall, signed with your name.

errors.closed: The soul has been reborn; this conversation is closed
errors.not_inbox: This is not a hall inbox

sentence_plan.between_stops: The soul is at home; the next stop has not begun
sentence_plan.accept_title: Accept the request on the sentence plan of {{soul}}
sentence_plan.reject_title: Reject the request on the sentence plan of {{soul}}
sentence_plan.accept_warning: Accepting changes the plan at once: added stops join it and removed stops leave it. Stops already begun are not touched.
sentence_plan.accept_reopen_warning: Accepting opens the reopened judgment at home at once, even while the soul is away. The current stop abroad carries on; once served, the soul waits there for the retrial to close.
sentence_plan.withdraw_warning: The original judge will no longer handle it. You can file it again later.
sentence_plan.cancel_warning: Cancelling pardons the rest of the sentence and counts the plan as complete: stops not begun are cancelled, a transfer under way is cancelled and the term being served ends. A soul abroad returns home, then goes on exactly as if the plan had been completed. This cannot be undone.
sentence_plan.cancel_reason: Reason (required, recorded in the audit log)
sentence_plan.inbox_subtitle: Requests to add or remove stops or to reopen a judgment, decided by the original judge
sentence_plan.inbox_empty_reason: Requests on plans your civilization owns, and requests it has filed, appear here

errors.open_judgment: The soul has an open judgment; decide once it is concluded or withdrawn
errors.plan_held: The plan is held on an eternal term; end that stop first
errors.plan_in_retrial: A retrial is already under way
errors.request_pending: This plan already has a request awaiting a decision
errors.request_closed: This request has already been handled
errors.not_home: Only the home civilization can do this
errors.not_requester: Only the civilization that filed it can withdraw it
errors.node_not_pending: A stop to be removed has already begun
errors.eternal_not_last: An eternal term must be the last stop
errors.soul_state: The soul's current state does not allow the plan to close
errors.empty_changes: Add or remove at least one stop
errors.foreign_node: Stops can be added only in your own civilization; elsewhere the home judge opens a joint judgment
errors.foreign_realm: That realm is not one of your civilization's
errors.unknown_node: No such stop on this plan
errors.soul_is_here: The soul is here; open an amendment judgment

cross.title: Sentence plan stops
cross.hint: The home civilization is always stop 1. Each co-judge or chair civilization then has one stop, filled in by its own judges; advisors carry none. An eternal term must be last.
cross.home_stop: Set by the original judgment when it concludes
cross.eternal_hint: This realm is an eternal term; this stop must be last
cross.years_invalid: Enter a whole number, zero or more
cross.eternal_not_last: An eternal term must be the last stop; in this order the bench will be refused when it concludes
cross.no_stops: No co-judge or chair is seated yet
cross.open_hint: The joint judgment sets the stops abroad; it must have ended before this case concludes.
cross.open_error: Could not open the joint judgment
cross.seat_actor_empty: This civilization has no deity who can take a seat
cross.seat_actor_hint_judging: A co-judge or chair must be a judge
cross.seat_actor_hint_advisor: Any serving deity may sit as an advisor

file.title: File a request with the original judge: {{soul}}
file.add_title: Stops to add (your own civilization only)
file.remove_title: Stops to remove (only stops not yet begun)
file.reopen_hint: Once accepted, the home civilization opens the retrial at once; its verdict decides how the plan changes.
file.submitted: Request filed; awaiting the original judge
file.soul_is_here: The soul is here now: open an amendment judgment and carry the changes when it concludes.

amend.title: Changes to the sentence plan
amend.hint: This is an amendment judgment. Concluding it creates no disposition; the changes go to the original judge as one request, and with no changes no request is filed.
